Question: Assalaamalaikum.My mother has passed away recently. I want to know how much amount i need to pay for each of her QAZA NAMAAZ??? And how many namaaz we have to calculate in a day, 5 or 6 (6 if include vitr of isha)???? To whom can this amount be paid??? Can i give this amount in any mosque??? Or in any madrasa??? Pls inform in light of Holy Quran and Hadees mubarak. Jazaa kumullah !!! Answer ID: 10036 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 147/99=H/1429) Fidyah (expiation) of one salah is 1.575 kg wheat one can pay either wheat or moderate market price of it. If you have missed so many prayers then calculate 6 salah of every day and get the total quantity of wheat as per the total number of salah and pay the fidyah accordingly . It should be given to the poor and needy who are entitled to receive Zakah. You can give it in a madrasa accommodating poor students. It cannot be spent in mosque, building madrasa or in giving salary. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
